findings: Within the current CLI source population, enforcementReady is constructed and rendered by ProofShadow; no execution consumer of that field was found. loadProofShadowReport serves the proof-report command.
Handler records shadow observations during verdict writing after execution, catches ledger errors, and does not use shadow decisions to alter which lanes ran.

Publish with reuseVerified calls assertReusableVerifiedState before commit preparation. That guard loads the separate verified-state artifact and compares branch, base and head selectors, current commit, Git status/diff fingerprint and full proof tier.
The inspected guard does not independently compare actual toolchain binaries, ambient environment, or current proof command. Exact-state reuse is not this packet’s complete qualified-tuple contract.

limits: Synthetic verified state was written only inside a disposable fixture; no real proof authority was minted.
The exact-state acceptance control does not constitute a successful full proof.

scope: Selected Handler publish/verdict paths, ProofState verified-state guard/fingerprint, and ProofShadow report consumer. This does not review full Handler or coordinator ownership machinery.
remaining: Full executable semantic closure, actual signed remote comparisons, accepted sibling authorities, and final adoption/closeout proof remain required.
No real ledger, verified-state artifact or cache configuration was changed by these controls.
